title: Spicy Korean Tamarind Chicken Skewers
description: Tender chicken pieces marinated in a sweet and spicy Korean-inspired tamarind sauce, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine tamarind paste, gochujang, honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, hot sauce, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together tamarind mixture, sesame oil, and 2 tablespoons water.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer skewers to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
